summary.plain: The international team of about 200 physicists from 34 institutes who built and ran the OPAL detector at CERN's LEP collider.
summary.technical: Approved by the CERN LEPC on 18 November 1982; about 200 physicists from 34 institutes in Canada, Germany, Hungary, Italy, Israel, Japan, the United Kingdom and the United States (OPAL's own welcome page).
